Integration seat (new session) p15 status, 18:05 MST.
- PR-4038: CLEARED. The 5 aida-cli failures (bug_2017 x2, story_1742 explicit_store_overrides, task_1736 x2) fail 3/3 at BOTH efc9261 and base c51e6d2 on dell1. The cause is ambient non-authoritative-clone state leaking into the tests ("global ID/block allocation requires an explicitly authoritative clone"), not #4038. Evidence is on BUG-2605.
- #4116: APPROVED at a209df3. I released its stale CHANGES REQUESTED hold with `aida merge-hold auto-release 4116`. Its red CI is a 12-minute "Ratchet set" step timeout: verify-manual.py started with ~1 minute left, after every ratchet test had passed. Re-checking locally.
- Candidate p15 = 33c679f (efc9261 + merge main fde1fb8 + merge #4116), on tmp/integration-p15. Gates running: local check-ci-fast, then on dell1 the lib set (gate/store/doctor plus #4116's drain_gate/phase_gates/bug_2398/bug_2451/queue_work/git_ops), integ-req, and the full aida-cli set.
- If #4116 turns red in the gates, I'll drop it and cut p15 with 4038 + main only. I'll send the PR number when it's open.
